verdict.rationale: The evidence never affirmatively documents a reserved-capacity or committed-use discount program, or how a platform engineer would lock one in. Long-term commitments and reservations appear only as contrasts in the pages describing on-demand and Spot capacity, and no pricing discount for sustained use is described. Quotas, Capacity Finder and billing insights are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity
